Commentary.Commentary: We are back for South Africa's reply. The players stride out to the middle. Janneman Malan and Quinton de Kock are the openers for South Africa. Jasprit Bumrah has the ball in hand. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

So a formidable total on the board for India and it will not be easy for South Africa to chase this down. Will we see the team batting first winning the game again or will South Africa chase this down? Stay tuned as the chase will begin shortly.

South African bowlers failed to get the early breakthrough courtesy of a dropped catch very early in the innings off the bowling of Nigidi against Rahul. It was the introduction of the spin that did the trick for South Africa as India lost a couple of wickets in quick time. After a brilliant partnership in the middle overs, it was Magala who provided the crucial breakthrough. The wickets started falling after that as Shamsi troubled the batters with his superb spin bowling. Credit to Bavuma for keeping Shamsi at the back end and it turned out to be a masterstroke in the end. Apart from sloppy fielding and catching, this has been a decent effort from South Africa.

The Indian innings promised quite a lot when the partnerships were going on at the start and in the middle overs but was halted as India lost important wickets in middle overs. Rahul and Dhawan gave India a good start but the introduction of spin saw India losing Dhawan and Kohli in quick succession. Pant came out with positive intent as always and made sure that Rahul is given good company. The pair notched up a century partnership with both getting to their respective fifties but just when things were looking rosy, India lost the plot with both set batters departing in quick succession. Still, Shardul Thakur and Ashwin managed to take India to a par score here and it is upto their bowlers now to defend this total.

The momentum has shifted from one team to another throughout the course of this innings and in the end, India have got to a good total here courtesy to Shardul Thakur's knock of 40 and credit to Ravichandran Ashwin for supporting him well. Hadn't it been Thakur's knock, India would have not breached the 260 mark as well. The pitch is on the slower side and strokeplay is difficult here. Both teams will feel that they are in with a chance and it will be interesting to see how South Africa approaches this chase.

FOUR! Yes, they can! Nice shot and nice timing on that one! It was a length ball, outside off. Ravichandran Ashwin gets inside the line of the ball and smacks it over covers for a boundary. India end things on high as they finish with 287/6.
Slower yorker, on middle. Ravichandran Ashwin goes deep and tucks it to deep square leg for a brace. Can India finish with a boundary?
A low full toss, outside off. Shardul Thakur goes back and bunts it down to long off for a single.
A low full toss, on middle. Shardul Thakur whips it to deep mid-wicket for another brace. India surely would want him to go big at the last three deliveries.
Fuller, outside off. Ravichandran Ashwin steers it to backward point for a single.
Caught but it was a free hit so won't matter. Outside off, Shardul Thakur gets inside the line and paddles it to short fine leg. The fielder takes the catch and the batters take a single.
Yorker, on middle. Shardul Thakur digs it to sweeper cover for a brace. Good running between the wickets. Sisanda Magala has overstepped and a no ball is signalled. Free hit coming up...
Sisanda Magala will bowl the last over.
Full and on off, Ravichandran Ashwin comes down the track and powers it to deep cover for a brace.

Three dots in a row! India wouldn't want dots at this stage. Excellent bowling this from Ngidi. Length ball, was a slower one outside off. Ravichandran Ashwin swings but misses. He looks at the umpire as he thinks it was a wide but the umpire thinks elsewise.
Play and a miss again! Slower ball, on a length, outside off. Ravichandran Ashwin swings at it but only connects it with thin air around him.
On a good length, outside off. Ravichandran Ashwin throws the kitchen sink at it but fails to connect.
Length ball, outside off. Ravichandran Ashwin whips it past square leg for a couple of runs.
Length ball, way too outside off. Shardul Thakur gets inside the line and works it towards point. The fielder misfields and allows a single.
Lungi Ngidi (7.0-0-30-0) is back into the attack.
On middle, blocked out.
On the pads, Shardul Thakur goes for the reverse sweep but the ball goes off the inside half to cover-point for a single.
Full and outside off, Ashwin drags it to long on for a run.

A tough chance but put down! Top effort from David Miller in the deep. Loopy ball, on off. Ravichandran Ashwin advances down the track and heaves it to long off. David Miller covers a lot of ground. He runs to his right and dives but couldn't held onto that one as he hits on the ground and the ball pops out of his hands. Two runs are taken.
Short and on leg, Ravichandran Ashwin goes for the pull but the ball stays a little low. It goes through his legs and Quinton de Kock collects it.

Tossed up, on leg. Ravichandran Ashwin again goes for the slog sweep but misses out on it this time. He gets hit on the pads and Tabraiz Shamsi appeals for an lbw but the umpire says no. Clearly going down leg.
WIDE! Sprays this one down the leg side, Ravichandran Ashwin looks to flick but misses. Wided.
Too full and outside off, just inside the tramline. Shardul Thakur looks to steer it down to third man but misses.
Full and on off, driven towards deep cover for a run.
SIX! Well played! It's Ravichandran Ashwin this time! Tossed up, on middle. Ravichandran Ashwin gets low and sweeps it over deep square leg for a biggie.
Outside off, Shardul Thakur sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Loopy ball, outside off. Shardul Thakur cuts it to deep point. He pushes hard for the second run and gets it comfortably.
On middle, Ravichandran Ashwin uses his feet to flick it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Shardul Thakur continues his attacking punch. 250 comes up for India! This was short and on middle, Shardul Thakur makes room and smashes it over covers for a boundary.
Drifting on the pads, Ravichandran Ashwin turns it to square leg for a single.
Outside off, Shardul Thakur slashes it to deep cover for just a single.
Slightly shorter on middle. Ashwin goes deep in his crease and nudges it to backward square leg for a single.
Shorter length around leg. Ashwin pulls it to short fine leg.
A slightly shorter length delivery and turning into the batter. Ashwin pushes this off the back foot to covers.
Outside off, pushed towards covers.
FOUR! Flatter, outside off. Shardul Thakur advances down the track and muscles it straight down the ground for a boundary.
On the pads, Ravichandran Ashwin pushes it to long on for a single.
Tossed up, on middle. Driven back to the bowler.
Slower through the air, on middle. Ravichandran Ashwin blocks it out.
Loopy ball, outside off. Shardul Thakur pushes it to long off for a single.
On middle and leg, Ravichandran Ashwin nudges it to mid-wicket.

OUT! STUMPING! Length ball, down the leg side. Iyer looks to flick but misses. He loses his balance a little and de Kock quickly whips the bails off. He asks the square umpire if it's out and the umpire takes it upstairs as he wasn't sure. Replay rolls in and the third umpire first checks if there is any edge on it. UltraEdge detects no spike. Now now now, de Kock was very quick indeed as Iyer's foot was in the air when the bails were dislodged. Similar dismissal of how Rishabh Pant got out in the first ODI. Really sharp work from Quinton de Kock behind the stumps. India lose their sixth wicket now. Ravichandran Ashwin walks out to bat.
Commentary.Howout: st Quinton de Kock b Andile Phehlukwayo

Commentary.Commentary: Is that a stumping?  There is an appeal for stumping against Venkatesh Iyer. The replay rolls in and the UltraEdge shows that there is no bat involved. It shows that Venkatesh Iyer's leg is not grounded when Quinton de Kock whiped the bails off. So Venkatesh Iyer has to walk back.
On middle, Shardul Thakur nudges it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
This is knocked back to the bowler.
FOUR! That was hit hard! On a length, right in the slot, on middle. Shardul Thakur smacks it right back past the bowler for a boundary.
Length ball, on off. Shardul Thakur smashes it hard towards mid off. The fielder carries the ball on a bounce.
Short of a length, on off. Venkatesh Iyer stabs the ball to point for a single.
On off, Venkatesh Iyer drives it down the ground for another single.
Tossed up, on off. Punched through covers off the back foot for a run.
Slower ball, on middle. Venkatesh Iyer gently pushes it towards covers for one.
Slower through the air, on middle. Shardul Thakur lifts it to long on for a single.
Loopy ball, on leg. Venkatesh Iyer eases it down to long on for one.
On middle, defended back to the bowler.
Fuller in length, on middle. Shardul Thakur clears his front leg and squeezes it out to mid-wicket.
SIX! Fanstastic hit! Much needed for India! An off-cutter, outside off. Shardul Thakur picks it early and deposits it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Short of a length, outside off. Shardul Thakur slaps the ball but straight to extra cover. The fielder there does well to dive to his left and stop the ball.
Dots and singles won't help India at this stage. These two need to change gears now. This was on a length, on off. Driven towards covers.
Fuller, outside off. Venkatesh Iyer frees his arms and drives it through covers. He crosses ends.
On a length, on off. Venkatesh Iyer pushes it to mid off.
Quicker one, around off. Venkatesh Iyer pushes it to deep point for a single. Just 3 runs from the over.
On the pads, Shardul Thakur whips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter, on middle. Shardul Thakur defends it out.
Floats it up, on off. Iyer punches it to mid off for one.
This is worked to mid-wicket.
Loopy ball, outside off. Venkatesh Iyer steers it to point.
In the air for some time but it is safe. A length delivery on off. Thakur works it aerially towards mid on. It falls well short of Bavuma there. A dot ball to end the over.
Back of a length,outside off. Thakur looks to cut it but misses.

PUT DOWN! Rassie van der Dussen is the culprit this time. A slower length delivery, outside off. Venkatesh Iyer skips down the track and looks to drive it towards the off side. He miscues it and the ball loops in the air towards covers. Rassie van der Dussen there jumps to take the catch. He gets his one hand to it but fails to pouch it. A single in the end.
Ohh..beaten this time! A good-length delivery around that fourth stump channel. Iyer looks to push at it but gets beaten off the outside edge.
A slower length delivery on off at 114 kph. Iyer taps it to point this time.
Shorter length delivery on off. Thakur pulls it to fine leg for just a single.
A fuller delivery on middle. Thakur works it to mid-wicket and gets a single this time.
A fuller delivery around leg. Thakur looks to clip it but the ball hits his pads and falls short of leg slip.
A flatter delivery outside off. Thakur looks to cut but misses.
A fuller delivery on middle and leg and turning in. Shardul Thakur looks to clip it but misses. The ball hits his pads and there is a slight appeal there but no damage done.
A fuller delivery around leg. Thakur looks to clip it but the ball brushes his pads and goes towards short fine leg.
Shorter in length and turning away from off. Iyer rocks back and cuts it to deep cover for a single.
A single to end the over! Back of a length, around off. Venkatesh Iyer punches it to deep cover for a single.
Shorter length delivery on off. Thakur pulls it to fine leg this time for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Shardul Thakur cuts it to deep point and Sisanda Magala at the deep runs to his left and saves a couple for his team with a dive. Two runs for Thakur.
A length delivery and nipping in this time. Thakur drives this to mid on.
WIDE! Short and down the leg side this time. Shardul Thakur ducks under it.
A fuller delivery on off. Venkatesh Iyer square drives it again towards point. The fielder there diving to his left half-stops it and a single is taken.
Lungi Ngidi starts with a length delivery on off. Venkatesh Iyer drives this to point.
A tossed up delivery on middle. Shardul Thakur looks to work it towards the on side. The ball hits his pads and the ball loops towards the on side.
Shardul Thakur is the new batsman in.

South Africa have taken a review for an LBW. UltraEdge shows no bat involved. Ball Tracking shows that the ball is pitching outside off, the impact is in line and is wickets hitting. The original decision will be overturned and South Africa have retained their review.

OUT! LBW! Tabraiz Shamsi gets his man this time. Shreyas Iyer departs! A fuller delivery on off and turning into the batter. Shreyas Iyer looks to clip it but misses. The ball hits his back pad and there is a huge appeal. The umpire is unmoved and South Africa take a review this time. The replay rolls in and the UltraEdge shows no bat involved. The Ball Tracker rolls and it shows that the ball is pitching outside off, the impact is in line and it's clipping the leg stump. So three reds and the decision will be overturned and Shreyas Iyer has to walk back. A big wicket this. Five down now and South Africa are chipping in with wickets.
A fuller delivery on off. Venkatesh Iyer pushes it to covers for a single.
A fuller delivery on middle. Shreyas Iyer drives it down to long on for a single.

Huge appeal from Shamsi! But they decide to not take a review. A fuller delivery on middle. Venkatesh Iyer looks to sweep but misses. He is hit on the pads and there is a huge appeal. But just a leg bye in the end.
Tossed up on off. Shreyas Iyer skips down the track and eases it to long on for a single.
SIX! Venkatesh Iyer takes full advantage of this Free Hit! A length ball, on off. Venkatesh Iyer stays deep in his crease and tonks it over long on for a maximum.
NO BALL! A short delivery on off. Shreyas Iyer pulls it to deep square leg for a single. Sisanda Magala has overstepped and a Free Hit is coming up now.
Back of a length, outside off. Venkatesh Iyer steers it to third man for a single.
On a length, on off. Shreyas Iyer blocks this with soft hands towards off side for a single.
A slower back-of-a-length delivery outside off at 119 kph. Venkatesh Iyer cuts this off the bottom of his blade to covers for a single.
Another length delivery around off. Shreyas Iyer steers it to third man for a single.
On a length, on off. Shreyas Iyer defends it towards point.
Shorter length delivery on middle. Shreyas Iyer pulls it to deep mid-wicket for just a single. Another tidy over for South Africa.
Tossed up on middle. Shreyas Iyer skips down the track and clips it to mid-wicket.
WIDE! A fuller delivery around leg and turning in. Shreyas Iyer looks to clip it but misses.
Venkatesh Iyer gets a single this time. A fuller delivery on off. Venkatesh Iyer drives this wide of cover and gets a single.
This time a fuller delivery on off. Driven to covers. Another dot ball.
Slightly shorter on off. Venkatesh Iyer goes deep in his crease and pushes it to backward point.
A fuller delivery on middle. Shreyas Iyer drives it to long on for a single.
Just one run from the over! A length ball, on off. Venkatesh Iyer taps it to point this time.
Another play and a miss! A good-length delivery again. This time it is wider outside off. Venkatesh Iyer looks to drive again but gets beaten again.
Ohh...Almost finds the edge this time! A good-length delivery around off. Venkatesh Iyer looks to drive but the ball seams away a tad and beats the outside edge of his blade.
Back of a length, on off at 136 kph. Venkatesh Iyer defends it towards the off side.
A short delivery this time outside off. Venkatesh Iyer lets it go.
A fuller delivery on middle and leg. Shreyas Iyer flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Nicely tossed up on off. Venkatesh Iyer drives it to covers this time. Three runs and a wicket from the over.
A fuller delivery on middle. Shreyas Iyer works it to mid-wicket and gets a single.
WIDE! Fuller and down the leg side. Shreyas Iyer looks to clip it but misses.
Shorter length, on off. Venkatesh Iyer cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
The new batter in is Venkatesh Iyer.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another wicket and one brings two here. Both the set batters are gone now. Shamsi is pumped up. A tossed up delivery on middle. Pant dances down the track and looks to launch it towards the on side. Got too close to the ball and hence, didn't get the elevation there. The ball goes towards long off and Aiden Markram there runs to his left and takes a good diving catch. Rishabh Pant departs too after a good knock. Big wicket for South Africa and they are back in the game now.
Commentary.Howout: c Aiden Markram b Tabraiz Shamsi

Commentary.Commentary: Slower in the air on off. Pant waits for it and late cuts it to short third man.
Shorter length on off. Pant cuts it to point this time.
A fuller delivery on middle. Pant clips it to deep square leg for another single. End of a successful over from Sisanda Magala.
His speed is up now! A length delivery outside off at 140 kph. Iyer punches it to deep cover for a single.
Slightly shorter on off. Pant  punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
A length delivery on middle. Pant works it to mid-wicket this time.
A length ball, around leg. Iyer works it to fine leg for a single. He is off the mark.
Shreyas Iyer walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Rahul departs just after the Drinks break! This dangerous partnership has been broken! Sisanda Magala gets his first ODI wicket! A length ball, on middle. Rahul looks to work it away but gets the leading edge towards short mid-wicket. Rassie van der Dussen there takes a fine catch. KL Rahul departs after a fine knock. He is disappointed as he shakes his head walking back to the pavilion. South Africa have an openingt now. Can they fightback?
Commentary.Howout: c Rassie van der Dussen b Sisanda Magala

Commentary.Commentary: Drinks! India have recovered really well after losing Shikhar Dhawan and Virat Kohli in quick succession and they have to thank KL Rahul and Rishabh Pant for that. Both have played well and are building along a nice partnership. South Africa have been little sloppy in the field and now need a breakthrough desperately while KL Rahul and Rishabh Pant would look to continue and take India close to a target of around 300.
Short delivery on off at 124 kph. Rahul rocks back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket. A single and he will retain the strike. 8 runs from the over and these two are going along nicely here.
Slightly shorter in length, on off. Pant cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
A slower full delivey at 109 kph on off. Rahul drives it to long on for a single.
A shorter length delivery again at 124 kph. Pant pulls it to backward square leg for a single.
Shorter length delivery on middle. Pant backs away and pulls it to mid-wicket this time.
FOUR! Pant is punishing South Africa here! A length ball, on off. Pant stays deep in his crease and just tonks it towards long off. One bounce into the fence. He moves into the 80s now.
A tight single! Length ball, on off. Rishabh Pant pushes it to mid off and takes off for a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Slower ball, at 113 kph, outside off. Rishabh Pant looks to drive. It goes off the bottom half of his blade back to the keeper.
On middle and leg, pushed to long on for a single.
Short of a length, outside off. Cut straight to point.
On the pads, clipped to mid-wicket for a single.
On a good length, on middle. Punched to mid on for a run.
Pant has changed his bat and also a bowling change for South Africa. Sisanda Magala (3-0-29-0) is back into the attack.
Back of a length, outside off. KL Rahul dabs it to short third man for one.
On off, pushed back to the bowler.
Slower delivery, on a length. Rishabh Pant slogs it one-handed. Luckily for him, it falls safely towards long on and the batters take a single.

FIFTY FOR KL RAHUL! His 10th fifty and first as a skipper as well. Length ball, on off. KL Rahul punches it to sweeper cover for a single. He will be definitely looking for a bigger score here especially after all the lifelines he has been given. These two would look to do just what Temba Bavuma and Rassie van der Dussen did in the second ODI.

On a length, on off. Rishabh Pant turns it to deep mid-wicket for a single. 100-run partnership comes up now between Rishabh Pant and KL Rahul. This has been an impressive partnership for India. Just what the doctor ordered.
Length ball, outside off. KL Rahul punches it to sweeper cover for one.

SIX! BANG! One-handed six! Rishabh Pant has started to cut loose. Loopy ball, on leg. Rishabh Pant dances down the track and hammers it over long on for a maximum. Looks like one-handed biggies have become a hallmark of Rishabh Pant.
FOUR! Pulled away! Short again, on middle. This time Rishabh Pant rocks back and pulls it to wide of long on for a boundary. Beats the man at mid on easily.
Short and outside off, Rishabh Pant makes room but could only push it towards covers.
On middle, clipped to mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed back to the bowler. KL Rahul went for the drive but gets it from the inner half of his bat.
A fuller delivery on off. Pant goes for the reverse-sweep this time. He gets the top edge towards the short third man region. A single taken as the ball falls short of the fielder.
Back of a length, outside off. KL Rahul hops and pats it back to the bowler.
Slower delivery, outside off. Rishabh Pant walks down the track and drills it to long on for a single.
Back of a length, on off. KL Rahul nudges it to mid-wicket for a run.
An off-cutter, on off. Turned to mid-wicket.

DROPPED! Short of a length, outside off. KL Rahul rocks back and cuts it hard towards backward point. Aiden Markram who is a gun fielder for South Africa drops the catch. It was straight at him but couldn't held onto it. South Africa now had three chances to see the back of KL Rahul and have missed all. Three lifelines given to KL Rahul. Let's see to what extent he takes the advantage of it.
On a length, outside off. KL Rahul guides it to backward point.
Slightly short, outside off. Rishabh Pant rocks back and cuts it to deep cover for a brace.
Full and on off, pushed to cover-point.
Outside off, spinning away. Left alone.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Tossed up, on middle. Rishabh Pant comes down the track and lifts it one-handedly towards long on for a boundary.
Tossed up, on middle and leg. Rishabh Pant looks to play the paddle scoop but gets himself in an awkward position and gets hit on the pads. He is on the floor after missing the shot.
Loopy ball, on middle. KL Rahul pushes it to long off for a single.
Outside off, on a length. Rahul drives it through covers for a single. 22 from the last two overs.
On middle, this is worked to long on for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Rishabh Pant taps it to point.
FOUR! Just Pant things! Was a short-of-a-length ball, down leg. Rishabh Pant went for the scoop but in the end just ramps it to fine leg for a boundary.
Length ball, outside off. KL Rahul cuts it to deep point for a single.

FIFTY FOR PANT! Short of a length, outside off. Rishabh Pant punches it to sweeper cover for a single. He has played a good knock here. A counter-attacking knock after India were put to trouble and he would want to convert this into a bigger one.
On middle, KL Rahul goes deep and tucks it to square leg. 14 from the over. A good over for India.
WIDE! Spinning away down the leg side. KL Rahul leaves it alone. Wided.
Flighted ball, outside off. Rishabh Pant drills it down to long off for a single. Moves to 49!
FOUR! Third boundary of the over! Loopy ball, outside off. Rishabh Pant throws his hands at it. This time it skews off the outside edge to third man for a boundary.
Some turn there! Short and spinning away outside off. Rishabh Pant defends it on the leg side.
FOUR! Intent from Pant! Brilliantly played! Full and on middle. Rishabh Pant sweeps it to deep square leg for another boundary.

FOUR! Welcomes the new bowler with a boundary. Tossed up, on off. Rishabh Pant gets low and slog-sweeps it to deep mid-wicket. Shouts of "catch" but the ball lands safely in the vacant area and races away for a boundary.
Tabraiz Shamsi is into the attack now.
Short of a length, on middle. Pulled to deep square leg for just a run.
On the pads, KL Rahul tucks it to deep square leg for one.
On a length, around off. Rishabh Pant taps it to point for a single.
Length ball, on off. Eased down to long on. KL Rahul crosses ends.
Same shot and similar result. It is guided to backward point where the fielder stops the ball diving to his left.
Length ball, outside off. KL Rahul guides it to backward point. Good timing on that one but not in the gap.
FOUR! Fifty partnership comes up between these two. Loopy ball, sliding down the leg side. Rishabh Pant tickles it to fine leg for a boundary.
Make that five! Full and on middle, Rishabh Pant tries to up the ante. He dances down the track and smashes the ball straight into the stumps at the other end.
Four dots in a row! Outside off, driven to cover.
Slower through the air, on middle. Pushed back to the bowler.
Loopy ball, outside off. Pant drives it towards covers.
Full and on middle, Rishabh Pant blocks it out.
Aiden Markram will continue. He has done decent job so far.
On a length, on middle and leg. KL Rahul chips it to mid-wicket. A good start by Andile Phehlukwayo. Just three runs from the over.
On the pads this time, it is worked to deep square leg for a single.
On a length, on off. Rishabh Pant defends it towards covers.
On middle, turned to mid-wicket.
Back of a length, on off. Rishabh Pant clips it to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Length ball, on off. Pushed towards covers.
Another shorter length delivery on off. Pant pushes it to covers this time. The fielder there half-stops it and a single is taken. Pant will retain the strike and another good over for India.
FOUR! Superb shot! Aiden Markram fires this on off and it is slightly short. Pant rocks back and cuts it through backward point for a boundary.
A fuller delivery on middle. Rahul eases it down to long on for a single.
Slightly shorter outside off. Pant cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
A fuller delivery outside off. Rahul drives it to deep cover for a single.
Nicely tossed up delivery on middle. Pant dances down the track and looks to launch it towards the on side. He gets the bottom of his blade and a single is taken towards long on. 100 up for India!
Slighly shorter in length around middle. Pant works this off the back foot to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! A rare bad delivery has been put away by Pant! A flatter delivery around leg. Pant paddle sweeps it towards long leg for a boundary. Nice shot.
A fuller delivery on off. Rahul drives it to long off for a single.
Another quick single. A flatter delivery on off. Pant drops it wide of cover and gets a single.
Nice loopy delivery on middle. Rahul pushes it with soft hands towards covers and gets a single.
A flatter delivery around leg. Pant works it to deep square leg for a single.
A tossed up delivery around off. Pant skips down the track and gets an easy single to long off.
A fuller delivery on off. Rahul pushes it square on the off side for a single.
FOUR! Bad ball from Aiden Markram and KL Rahul takes full advantage of it. Was short and down leg, KL Rahul sits on one knee and smashes it to backward square leg. One bounce and into the ropes.
On middle and leg, pushed back to the bowler.
Loopy ball, on off. KL Rahul looks to work it on the leg side but gets an outside edge towards covers.
Full and wide outside off, Rishabh Pant steers it to deep cover for one.
FOUR! Nicely played! A fuller delivery around leg. Rahul tucks it fine towards long leg for a boundary.
Nicely tossed up around leg. Rahul works it to mid-wicket.
A fuller delivery on off. Pant skips down the track and works it wide of mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! This is the answer Pant has given for all the trouble he was facing. A fuller delivery on off. Pant gets on his knee and slog-sweeps it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
This is down the leg side. Pant looks to sweep it but gets it only towards short fine leg.
A fuller delivery on off. Pant pushes it to covers this time.

DRINKS! The spinners are doing the job for South Africa and got the two in-form batters in Shikhar Dhawan and Virat Kohli. They could have had KL Rahul as well but a huge blunder from Keshav Maharaj let that chance slip through their hands. Rishabh Pant and KL Rahul will now try to rebuild the innings while South Africa will look to continue keep things tight and not allow the momentum slip away.
A flatter delivery on off. Pant dabs it wide of cover and gets a quick single.
Shorter length, on off. Pant looks to cut but gets the bottom edge of his blade wide of stumps.
A flatter delivery on middle. Pant works it to mid-wicket and there is another piece of miscommunication between the batters but no damage done.
A flatter delivery on middle and leg. Pant looks to flick it but misses. There is an appeal for LBW but is turned down.
Shorter outside off. Pant cuts it to covers this time.
On middle, pushed to long on for a single.

Comedy of errors here! Unbelievable stuff! A flatter delivery on middle. Pant works it to mid-wicket and Bavuma there is quick to stop it. Pant at first calls for a single but sees Temba Bavuma make the stop so just stops running. KL Rahul though is more than halfway down the track and both the batters are stranded at the striker's end. Bavuma throws the ball to the bowler's end but Maharaj fails to collect the throw and there was no one backing him up which allows Rahul to come back to his crease. KL Rahul is not at all happy with what just happened. Has a stare at Rishabh Pant and has a few words with him as well.
Shorter length around leg. Pant pulls it to backward square leg for a couple.
A flatter delivery this time on off. Rahul pushes it to sweeper cover and gets another single.
Fuller delivery at 84 kph on off. Pant turns it to long on for a single.
Fuller again on middle. Rahul pushes it to deep cover for a single.
Tossed up around middle. Rahul defends it watchfully off the front foot.
Loopy ball, on middle. KL Rahul turns it to square leg for a single. South Africa keeping things very tight here. Only one run off this over.
Slower in the air. Rahul just defends this onto the pitch.
Another loopy delivery on off. Rahul blocks it.
Tossed up on off. Rahul defends it watchfully.
Slightly slower in the air on off. Rahul pushes it towards the off side and looks for a single but is sent back by his partner.
A quicker delivery on off. Rahul goes on the back foot andf punches it back to the bowler.
A flatter delivery on middle. Worked towards square leg.

Ohh...just short of slip. Maharj bowling in those footmarks outside off. Pant skips down the track and looks to turn it towards the on side. He gets the inside edge onto his body and ball loops and falls just short of the diving first slip fielder.
Rishabh Pant is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Virat Kohli departs now and spinners are doing the trick for South Africa. Nicely tossed up delivery on off. Virat Kohli drives it on up and is not upto the pitch of the ball. He drives it with just one-handed and the ball goes in the air towards covers. Temba Bavuma there takes an easy catch. So Virat Kohli departs without troubling the scorers and India are in some trouble now.
Commentary.Howout: c Temba Bavuma b Keshav Maharaj

Commentary.Commentary: Another good delivery on middle. Kohli blocks it out.
Turn and bounce there! A tossed up delivery on middle. Kohli plays it late as the ball turns away sharply.
A tossed up delivery on off. Rahul defends it with soft hands towards the off side for a quick single.
Another flatter delivery on middle. Kohli works it behind square this time. Another dot ball and end of a brilliant over from Aiden Markram.
Shorter length on off. Kohli tucks it to square leg.
Virat Kohli walks out to bat at No.3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Shikhar Dhawan departs and this is a big wicket for South Africa. A fuller delivery on off. Shikhar Dhawan goes for the sweep shot and times it really well but it was hit too flat. The ball goes in the air towards deep square leg and Sisanda Magala there takes a fine catch by moving to his right. Aiden Markram is delighted and Shikhar Dhawan the in-form batter has to walk back.
Commentary.Howout: c Sisanda Magala b Aiden Markram

Commentary.Commentary: Another loppy delivery on off. Shikhar Dhawan blocks this off the front foot.
FOUR! Nice use of feet by Shikhar Dhawan. A tossed up delivery on off. Shikhar Dhawan skips down the track and whips this towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary. Good shot.
Slower in the air on off. Rahul nudges it to square leg for a single.
Tossed up on off. Shikhar Dhawan just blocks it towards the off side. An excellent start from Keshav Maharaj. Just a run off it.
This time slower in the air on middle. Worked towards square leg.
Quicker in air on off. Dhawan is solid in his front foot defence again.
A fuller delivery on off. Dhawan defends it towards the off side.
Shorter in length and around leg. Dhawan looks to clip it away but misses and gets hit on the pads. It is going down leg.
Keshav Maharaj starts with a fuller delivery on middle. Rahul drives it to wide of long off for a single.
End of Powerplay 1! That means now 4 fielders will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle until the end of 40th over. Also a bowling change. Keshav Maharaj is brought into the attack now.
Excellent from Aiden Markram! Just 2 singles off the over. Flighted ball, outside off. KL Rahul clips it to long on for a single.
Full and on middle. KL Rahul glances it to short fine leg.
Flatter ball, on off. Shikhar Dhawan advances down the ground and punches it to long off for a single.
Outside off, driven straight to extra cover.
Loopy ball, outside off. Shikhar Dhawan blocks it out.
Tossed up, on middle. Shikhar Dhawan presses forward to block.
Back of a length, on off. KL Rahul chops it back to the keeper.
Outside off, driven towards covers.
Slower length delivery, outside off. KL Rahul guides it to third man for a brace.
No run.Outside off, KL Rahul dabs the ball to the off side.
FOUR! Fifty up for India! Fuller and outside off, KL Rahul drives it through point. The fielder there misfields and allows the ball to race away for a boundary.
Well fielded! On a good length, outside off. KL Rahul steers it behind point. Aiden Markram dives to his left and stops a certain boundary.
On the pads, worked to deep square leg for a single. Good start from Aiden Markram. 4 runs from the over.
Flatter and quicker, on off. Tapped to cover for a quick single.
Tossed up, on off. Shikhar Dhawan prods and blocks it out very watchfully.
Full and on off, KL Rahul works it to long on for a run.
Floats it up, on middle. Turned to mid-wicket.
Loopy, full and on off. Shikhar Dhawan pushes it to long off for a single.
Aiden Markram is into the attack now. He replaces Sisanda Magala.

On a good length, outside off. Shikhar Dhawan guides it to sweeper cover for just a run. Lungi Ngidi is keeping things tight from one end but Sisanda Magala is leaking runs from the other. Just 3 runs from this over.
Short of a length, on middle. Shikhar Dhawan pulls it to deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Slower one again, on middle. Shikhar Dhawan pats it back to the bowler.
Slower one from Lungi Ngidi, on middle, at 113 kph. Shikhar Dhawan pushes it towards covers with soft hands. He sets off for a single but is sent back by his skipper.
Good-length ball, on off. Shikhar Dhawan defends it back to the bowler.
On a length, around off, from 'round the wicket. Shikhar Dhawan pushes it towards covers.
On middle, clipped behind square on the leg side for a single.
Length ball, outside off. KL Rahul steers it to deep point for a single.

FIVE WIDES! Shocker from Sisanda Magala. Second time he has done that. A wayward delivery, going way down the leg side. Quinton de Kock dives to his left but in vain as the ball races away to fine leg. Maybe it slipped out of Magala's hands.
Change of pace from Sisanda Magala, bowls a slower one, on middle, at 116 kph. Shikhar Dhawan clips it to square leg for one.
Fuller in length, on off. KL Rahul drives it towards extra cover for a single. Temba Bavuma scores a direct hit at the bowler's end but KL Rahul was inside the crease.
Outside off, dabbed to backward point.
On a length, around off. KL Rahul taps it towards covers. That was solidly defended off the front foot.
On a length, outside off. Shikhar Dhawan chops the ball back to the keeper. Lungi Ngidi is making him play the ball too close to his body.
Back of a length, on middle. Rahul turns it to mid-wicket. He rotates the strike taking a single.
On a length, on middle. Nudged to mid-wicket.
On the pads, worked to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played! On a length, outside off. Shikhar Dhawan comes down the track and smashes it over covers for a boundary.

DROPPED! Janneman Malan is on the ground with his head down. He knows this could prove very costly. Back of a length, outside off. KL Rahul slashes it towards gully. Janneman Malan leaps and gets his left hand on it but puts it down. A single is taken. The ball came quickly than he anticipated.
Length ball, outside off. Shikhar Dhawan taps it to point. Good comeback from Sisanda Magala after getting hit for a boundary. 5 runs from the over.
Good-length ball, on middle. Shikhar Dhawan forces it to mid on.
Length ball, outside off. Pushed to mid off for a single.
On a length, attacking the stumps. KL Rahul gets inside the line and pushes it to mid off.

FOUR! KL Rahul gets his first boundary now. It was a bad ball and rightly punished. Outside off, too much width given, KL Rahul latches onto it and caresses it through point for a boundary. Sisanda Magala is clearly struggling with his line and length here.
Length ball, outside off. KL Rahul pushes it towards covers.
FOUR! Allows Shikhar Dhawan to free his arms and gets punished. Touch fuller, outside off. Shikhar Dhawan leans onto it and creams his drive through covers for a boundary.
Short of a length, on off. Shikhar Dhawan taps it towards covers. Played this shot with his bat too close to his body.
On a good length, outside off. Shikhar Dhawan leaves it alone this time.
Good-length ball, outside off. Shikhar Dhawan looks to push it to the off side but gets beaten on the outside edge. That's beautiful bowling from Lungi Ngidi.
Good-length ball, on off. Shikhar Dhawan dabs it towards backward point. Aiden Markram dives full stretch to his right and stops the ball. Excellent stop by him.
Length ball, on middle. KL Rahul nudges it to mid-wicket and scampers across for a quick single.
FOUR! That's nicely played! Too easy for "Gabbar". This was on the pads, Shikhar Dhawan simply wrists it to deep square leg and bags another boundary. A good over for India. 15 runs coming off it.
On a good length, on middle and leg. Shikhar Dhawan prods and defends it out.
That's better! Length ball, outside off. Shikhar Dhawan taps it towards covers.

FIVE WIDES! That's wild from Magala. Errs in his line and bowls a length ball way down the leg side. Quinton de Kock dives full stretch to his right but still couldn't collect the ball. It races away to fine leg for a boundary.
Much better from Magala! On a good length, around off. Shikhar Dhawan stays deep and taps it to point.

FOUR! Off the mark and in some fashion. First boundary of India's innings as well. He is carrying from where he left off. On a length, on the pads. Shikhar Dhawan turns it through mid-wicket and the ball races away to the boundary.
WIDE! Shikhar Dhawan faces his first ball but it is down the leg side. Dhawan looks to flick but misses. Wided by the umpire.
Sisanda Magala starts with a back-of-a-length ball, on off. KL Rahul stands up on his toes and guides it to third man for a single.
Sisanda Magala will start from the other end.
A single to end the over! A tidy over from Lungi Ngidi. This was a length ball, outside off. KL Rahul dabs it down to third man for a single.
Back of a length, on middle and leg. KL Rahul hops and blocks it out from the crease. This is a good start by Lungi Ngidi. Not allowing KL Rahul to free his arms.
Four dots in a row! On a good length, outside off. KL Rahul watches the ball closely and leaves it alone.
On a length, outside off. KL Rahul dabs it to the man at backward point.
Lungi Ngidi goes full this time, outside off. KL Rahul looks for the drive but only manages to roll it down to mid on.
Good start by Lungi Ngidi! Bowls a good-length ball, on off. KL Rahul covers the line, keeps his head position straight and meets the ball with a dead bat. It rolls towards covers.

So we are done with national anthems. South African players are in huddle and they take their field positions now. Indian openers, KL Rahul and Shikhar Dhawan jog out to the middle. South African players take knee to show their support for the Black Lives Matter movement. Lungi Ngidi to start with the ball for South Africa. Here we go...
We are all set to begin! Both teams are ready for the national anthems. It will be India's first followed by the South African.

Temba Bavuma, the skipper of South Africa says that they would have wanted to bat first with the nature of the wicket. He states that there will be an opportunity in the first hour for the bowlers. He adds that they were in trouble early with the bat in the first game and bowling was 80-85 per cent and it was not a perfect game. He mentions that they want to get better today and have a better understanding of the conditions and hopefully they will perform better. He informs that they have one change with Sisanda Magala coming in for Marco Jansen.

KL Rahul, the Indian skipper says that it's the second game on the same strip and it will be important for them to get some runs on the board and the wicket will slow down. He adds that they lacked a bit with the bat and with the ball in the middle overs and they needed one more partnership with the bat. Mentions that the batters realised after the match that they need to put together a few more partnerships and rectify it. Informs that they are going with the same XI.

South Africa (Playing XI) - Quinton de Kock (WK), Janneman Malan, Temba Bavuma (C), Aiden Markram, Rassie van der Dussen, David Miller, Andile Phehlukwayo, Sisanda Magala (In place of Marco Jansen), Keshav Maharaj, Tabraiz Shamsi, Lungi Ngidi.

India (Unchanged Playing XI) - KL Rahul (C), Shikhar Dhawan, Virat Kohli, Shreyas Iyer, Rishabh Pant (WK), Venkatesh Iyer, Shardul Thakur, Ravichandran Ashwin, Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Jasprit Bumrah, Yuzvendra Chahal.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and it lands in favour of India. They have opted to BAT first.

India, on the other hand, failed to play consistent cricket over a longer period of time. They were poor in the middle overs both with ball and bat and at the end that proved to be the difference between the two sides. India need wickets  in the middle overs and giving some overs to Venkatesh Iyer, the designated all-rounder in the team will provide more flexibility to the skipper, KL Rahul. The senior duo of Dhawan and Kohli were looking solid in the first game and they will be looking to convert those fifties into a big total in this game. But it is the young middle-order that need to step up and contribute more if India want to level the series here. Not many changes are expected in both the teams after just one game and it all depends on which team executes its skills better on the day. Can India level the series and keep their hopes of winning the series alive? Or will South Africa seal the ODI series in the second game itself? Either way, expect a riveting contest. Stay tuned for toss and further updates.

South Africa, are looking like a team high on confidence. There were moments when they were under the pump both with bat and ball in the first game but they came back strongly to register a comprehensive victory in the first game. Temba Bavuma and Rassie van der Dussen who were in good form in the Test series continued their form in the first ODI and notched up their respective centuries to take South Africa to a formidable total. The bowling led by their spin duo of Keshav Maharaj and Tabraiz Shamsi made sure that India despite looking good till the halfway mark of the chase, lose their way in the latter half. This South African team is now looking like a settled unit and a series win here will go a long way in building the confidence of this team.

Hello and a very warm welcome to the second ODI of this three-match ODI series between South Africa and India. South Africa have continued their winning momentum into the ODI series and are now just one win away from sealing this ODI series. India, on the other hand, are in a do-or-die situation and they will be desperately looking to get back to the winning ways after a pretty ordinary performance in the first ODI. The venue and the conditions remain the same so it will be interesting to see how both teams apply themselves on the field in this second ODI.
... MATCH DAY …
